title: 1648. Sell Diminishing-Valued Colored Balls

examples.explanation: Sell the 1st color 1 time (2) and the 2nd color 3 times (5 + 4 + 3). The maximum total value is 2 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 14.
Sell the 1st color 2 times (3 + 2) and the 2nd color 4 times (5 + 4 + 3 + 2). The maximum total value is 3 + 2 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 19.
